Commentary.Commentary: Ireland will be disappointed with how they ended. The likes of Barry McCarthy, Mark Adair and Craig Young were excellent with the new ball. The spinners did a decent job too in the middle overs but later on, they leaked far too many runs and will feel they let Nepal off the hook. Now the target is not a big one and Ireland do have the batters to gun it down. Nepal on the other hand, have momentum on their side. Can they chase this down?

That is a brilliant recover from Nepal! They have got themselves to a total which can be considered more than competitive. They were struggling throughout the innings, They kept losing wickets at regular intervals and at one stage they were reeling at 169 for 7. However, Sandeep Lamichhane and Gulsan Jha played the rescue act and took their side to a brilliant score. Jha was the mainstay with a brilliant half ton.
SIX! BANG! finishes the innings off in style! Top shot. Shorter and on middle, this is nailed over mid-wicket and it goes all the way. Nepal END WITH 268!

Hello and welcome to the action between Ireland and Nepal where these two will fight for the 7th place playoff. Ireland were one of the favorites to finish top two in the World Cup Qualifiers but missed out due to their inconsistency. With the likes of Paul Stirling, Joshua Little and Harry Tector, Ireland had a really good chance but things didn't click for them at the right time. However, Ireland have picked things at the right time and will hope to end the tournament with a high and are favourites to win here against Nepal who have to be right on their toes to win against the Irish team.
